question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

This game will not be played by you.

options.text: You will not play this game.
You will not be playing this game.
You could not play this game.
You had not play this game.

solution:
The correct answer is "**You will not play this game**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As we can see, the given sentence is in the passive voice format of the **simple future tense** as the **third form of the verb (played)** along with "**will**" is applied in the sentence, so we have to **change** the** **voice as per the **same tense rules**.
 
• **Active voice**: Subject + **will + not + V1 + **object
 
• **Passive voice**: Object +** will + not + be + V3 + by** + Subject
 
• Example:
 
 
• Active voice: *Maya** will** **clean** the dishes.*
 
• Passive voice: *The dishes** will not be cleaned by** Maya.*
 
 
 
• By following the above-mentioned rules, we have to change the **passive to active **by applying the** first form of the verb (play)** in the **sentence.**

 

**Therefore, the correct answer is:** *You will not play this game*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us take a look at the rules of simple future active passive voice:
 
• **Active** voice: Subject + **will + v1 +** object.
 
• **Passive** voice: Object+ **will + be + V3 + by **+ subject
 
• **Active** voice: Subject + **will + not + V1**+object
 
• **Passive** voice: Object + **will + not + be + V3 + by** Subject
 
• **Active** voice: **Will **+ Subject **+ V1 +** object+?
 
• **Passive** voice: **Will **+ Object +** be + v3 + by **+ subject+?
